input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button remains disabled after a failed export due to the `busy` state not being reset when `exportReport` throws an error. The `handleClick` function only resets `busy` in the `.then()` callback, leaving it stuck if the promise rejects.

input.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function sets `busy` to `true` but does not reset it if the `exportReport` call fails. This leaves the Export button disabled after a failed export. The fix is to wrap the `exportReport` call in a `try-catch` block and set `busy` to `false` in the `catch` block to re-enable the button.

input.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function sets `busy` to `true` but does not reset it if the `exportReport` call fails. This leaves the Export button disabled after a failed export. The fix is to wrap the `exportReport` call in a `try-catch` block and set `busy` to `false` in the `catch` block to re-enable the button.
